name: Additional fused-switch pole
summary: An additional fused-switch pole represents another conductor of a common multipole device.
description: An additional fused-switch pole represents another conductor of a common multipole device. Each fuse-link and pole needs its terminal and phase identification while the common operating mechanism stays linked.
readingNotes: A shared device tag should not conceal different fuse ratings on separate conductors.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A child pole is a CAD representation of a common device, not an extra independently operated fused switch.
